_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

Updated [`plan.md`](plan.md) from a backend-only plan to a **two-part** implementation plan.

### Header and scope
- Title covers **`backend/`** (complete) and **`frontend/`** (not started).
- **§1.2** adds Part II scope; **§1.3** no longer blocks frontend (Part II owns it).
- **§2** adds UI sources: `spec/ui-flow.md`, `rules/frontend.md`, `commands/review-frontend.md`, assessment docs, demo **§8.7**.

### Part II — **§20** (`frontend/`)
Phased slices with gates **FG0–FG4**:

| Phase | Focus |
|--------|--------|
| **UI-A** | Scaffold (Node 24, Next + Vite, env example) |
| **UI-B** | HTTP client + envelopes (`src/api/`) |
| **UI-C** | Shell + **DEC-20** routes |
| **UI-D / UI-E** | List → search, filter, pagination |
| **UI-F** | Create (can run parallel with D/E after C) |
| **UI-G / H / I / J** | Detail read → Save → comments → status |
| **UI-K** | `/ask` (parallel after C+B) |
| **UI-L** | Demo **§8.7** + `review-frontend` |

Includes:
- Target **`frontend/`** tree (matches `rules/frontend.md`)
- Dependency diagram for parallel work
- Per-slice work items, done criteria, **AC-UI** mapping (**§20.16**)
- Non-goals checklist (**§20.17**)
- **§16.1** one-line frontend index
- Sign-off rows for **UI-A…UI-L**

Backend sections **§6–§19** are unchanged in substance; Part I stays marked complete. Say if you want **`tasks.md`** generated from **UI-A** first or **`rules/frontend.md`** updated to drop the “no `frontend/` until requested” line now that the plan authorizes it.

_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

The new work is **Part II** in [`plan.md`](plan.md) — **§20**, under `frontend/`. Backend phases **A–F** and **G** are unchanged.

### Frontend gates (FG0–FG4)
| Gate | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| **FG0** | `frontend/` package, Node 24, `next dev` on 3000, `.env.example` |
| **FG1** | Single HTTP client; envelope parsing |
| **FG2** | **DEC-20** routes + nav |
| **FG3** | **AC-UI-01…07** (CRUD, search/filter, comments, status, errors) |
| **FG4** | **AC-UI-08…12**, demo **§8.7**, `review-frontend` Pass |

### Frontend phases (UI-A → UI-L)
| Phase | What it builds |
|--------|----------------|
| **UI-A** | Scaffold (Next + Vite, tooling, env) |
| **UI-B** | API client (`src/api/`) |
| **UI-C** | App shell + route stubs |
| **UI-D** | Ticket list (basic GET, loading/empty) |
| **UI-E** | List search `q`, status filter, pagination |
| **UI-F** | Create ticket form → 201 → detail |
| **UI-G** | Ticket detail (read-only) |
| **UI-H** | Detail field Save (PATCH, no status) |
| **UI-I** | Comments |
| **UI-J** | Status transition buttons + 409 UX |
| **UI-K** | `/ask` (answer, citations, no-match) |
| **UI-L** | Demo hardening + `review-frontend` |

**Suggested order:** UI-A → B → C, then D→E, F (parallel with D/E after C), G→H/I/J, K (parallel after C+B), then L.

The sign-off table in **§17** has rows for **UI-A…UI-L** (all **not started**).
